baseline_outcome.negative_design_filter: The silver K3 H9 and golden OG10 H10 intrinsic norm-two carriers are eliminated from finite volume by infinite complete-chamber stabilizers, not by finite Vinberg prefixes.
baseline_outcome.positive: Bugaenko H8 is an exact compact K3 eigen-nef realization.

external_theorem_inputs: surjectivity of the marked K3/hyperkahler period map and the projectivity criterion
K3 Weyl transitivity or a deformation-type-specific Kahler/movable chamber theorem
boundedness/classification of MBM wall squares for the fixed deformation type
Borel-Harish-Chandra arithmeticity and the anisotropic compactness criterion

theorem_scope.finite_shell_reduction: For each allowed negative Beauville wall square, visibility forces h(delta,delta) into a finite set of totally positive elements cut out by one trace equation.
not_automatic: primitive embedding of an abstract Coxeter Gram without a fixed integral scaling
equality with a nef, movable, or Kahler chamber
Coxeter angles for arbitrary projected walls
theorem_scope.uniformity_obstruction: An admissible form with every non-distinguished real place definite is F-anisotropic.  For a complete invariant integral reflection arrangement, finite chamber volume is equivalent to compactness and to finiteness of its arithmetic chamber stabilizer.
theorem_scope.weak_full_picard_criterion: For a fixed admissible trace datum and deformation type, a weak full-Picard eigencarrier exists iff its even trace lattice admits an orientation-compatible primitive embedding in the Beauville lattice.
